overall: The AG found the Natick School Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law. Under 940 CMR 29.05(9)(b), its response deadline after mediation was extended by timely granted extensions, and it responded by November 29 within that window.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to respond within 14 business days to three OML complaints (#1, #2, #200), citing a September 12 mediation deadline.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Committee timely responded to the complaints and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
